"Her Majesty" | | | | +-----------------------------------------------------------------------+ | | +---------------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------+ "You Never Give Me Your Money" is a song by the Beatles that opens the climactic medley on side two of the album Abbey Road. It was written by Paul McCartney and is credited to Lennon-McCartney. The song was composed in the midst of the break-up of the band, during the Allen Klein phase. ©1969 Sony/ATV Music Publishing LLC. All rights reserved. Used by permission.
